purpose: Hand-authored (Claude, not Gemini) multi-label requirements for the 'hr_payroll' domain, to teach the BERT classifier category semantics outside BFSI vocabulary. Every item is UNVERIFIED and needs a human label pass before it enters permanent training data.
instructions_for_reviewers: Confirm each 'categories' list against your project's 13-category definitions; add/remove labels.
Watch for over-labelling with 'Functional' -- keep it only where the system performs a concrete action.
'Regulatory' = a legal/standard mandate; 'Security' = protection mechanism. Don't conflate.
Single-label items are fine. Flip 'verified' to true only after a human check.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow an employee to submit a leave request specifying leave type, dates, and reason for approval by their reporting manager.
The system shall calculate each employee's monthly net pay from gross salary, statutory deductions, and voluntary deductions.
The system shall deduct income tax at source according to the employee's declared investment proofs and the applicable tax slabs.
The system shall disburse salaries to employee bank accounts on the last working day of each month through a bank payment file.
The system shall restrict access to employee salary and bank details to the payroll team and the individual employee.
The system shall obtain employee consent before sharing personal data with third-party benefits providers.
The system shall generate year-end tax certificates and statutory filings for each employee at the close of the financial year.
The system shall maintain an audit trail of every change to an employee's compensation, including who made the change and when.
The payroll system shall be available at least 99.5 percent of the time and shall not be unavailable during the monthly pay-run window.
The system shall complete the monthly payroll calculation for fifty thousand employees within two hours.
The system shall let an HR administrator configure leave policies, pay components, and approval workflows without developer involvement.
The system shall import daily clock-in and clock-out records from the biometric attendance system.
The system shall prevent a manager from approving their own leave, expense, or reimbursement requests.
The system shall provide employees a self-service portal to view payslips, tax statements, and leave balances.
The system shall retain payroll records for a minimum of eight years in accordance with statutory requirements.
The system shall notify an employee and their manager when a leave request is submitted, approved, or rejected.
The system shall calculate gratuity, provident fund, and other statutory contributions using the current legally mandated rates.
The system shall allow the finance team to generate a payroll cost report broken down by department, location, and cost centre.
The system shall recover from a data-centre failure within a recovery time objective of four hours with no loss of approved payroll data.
The system shall mask employee bank account and national identification numbers on all reports except those explicitly authorised for payroll processing.
The system shall run a nightly job to accrue leave balances and shall alert operations if the job does not finish by 6 AM.
The system shall let an employee raise a payroll query and track its resolution through a ticketing workflow.
The system shall onboard a new employee, including their profile, pay structure, and statutory registrations, within one working day.
The system shall validate that total deductions never exceed gross pay for any employee in any pay period.
The system shall provide auditors read-only access to historical payroll runs and their supporting calculations.
The system shall localise payslip layout, currency, and statutory fields for each country in which the company operates.
The system shall encrypt all employee personal and financial data at rest and in transit.
The system shall reconcile the salary payment file against the bank's confirmation file and flag any failed credits for reprocessing.
The system shall allow employees to update tax-saving investment declarations only within the declaration window defined by the finance team.
The system shall archive payslips older than seven years to cold storage while keeping them retrievable within forty-eight hours on request.
